submission.body:
One defect remained: src/compiler/resolve-execution.ts line 4 still imported `type WorkflowRunId` from ../domain/primitives, although the file already used `WorkflowExecutionId` at line 20. primitives.ts no longer exports the old name, so the import was broken. I changed the import to `WorkflowExecutionId`.

After that, a repo-wide grep finds `WorkflowRunId` only in docs/migration.md and CHANGELOG.md, where it is deliberately described as the old name. The remaining `WorkflowRun` interface and the `workflow_run_id` field are separate symbols, and I left them alone.

`bun test` passes (86 pass, 0 fail). I couldn't run `tsc` because `npx` isn't available in the container, so the typecheck is unverified.
